```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)

expand_range <- function(x) {
  map_chr(x, ~ {
    .x |> str_split(",\\s*") |> unlist() |>
      map_chr(~ if (str_detect(.x, "-")) {
        nums <- as.numeric(str_split(.x, "-")[[1]])
        paste(seq(nums[1], nums[2]), collapse = ",")
      } else .x) |>
      paste(collapse = ",")
  })
}

questions <- read_csv("prompts/WVS_prompts_v4_English - Questions.csv") %>% mutate(Original_ID = expand_range(Original_ID), ValidIntegers = expand_range(ValidIntegers), ValidLengths = expand_range(ValidLengths))

additional_content <- read_csv("prompts/WVS_prompts_v4_English - Additional content.csv")
names <- names(additional_content)
additional_content <- additional_content %>% unlist() %>% as.vector() %>% setNames(names)

prompts <- questions %>% mutate(Before = additional_content[Before], After = additional_content[After], Prompt = paste(Before, Question, After, sep = "\n"), Instructions = additional_content[Instructions]) %>% select(Original_ID, Name, Prompt, Instructions, ValidIntegers, ValidLengths)

write_csv(prompts, "prompts/processed_prompts.csv")

```
